jeff.prompt: This is an isolated installed-package capability trial with synthetic data, not Alex's live world. Use the existing installed board actions, not package edits or direct world.transact workarounds. Planning (trial-planning) and Review (trial-review) reference the same OAS risks note trial-note-a. Two open Notes windows show Planning. Add a second appearance of the risks note in Planning at x=20,y=340, without copying its content. Then move only that new appearance 40 pixels right using the board layout action. Leave Review and the original appearance unchanged. Verify the actual rendered appearances in both windows. If the installed actions cannot express this, report that accurately. Do not author a workaround or access other worlds. Briefly explain which operation felt direct and what was missing.
jeff.reply:
The installed actions cannot complete this trial.

- `add_note` at `(20,340)` refused: **“This note is already on the board.”**
- No new appearance exists, so I did not invoke layout and risk moving the original.
- Planning, Review, and the shared note remain unchanged at revision 1.

In the observation browser, both windows’ DOMs contain one risks card and one agenda card. Only one window had visible geometry; the other reported a zero-sized viewport, so full rendered verification of both remains incomplete.

Adding an existing reference felt direct. What’s missing is creating a second, independently identified appearance of the same note on one board. No workaround or package edits were made.
